snippet.title: Green Mist Over Portland - Official Release Window Trailer | DevGamm Awards 2026
snippet.description:
Berlin, 1963. An MI6 officer has vanished without a trace, and a Cold War conspiracy is waiting to be uncovered. Green Mist Over Portland gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and a release window. Check out the Green Mist Over Portland release window trailer for this detective noir puzzle game from Bushmonkey Games.
 
Play as two investigators working on opposite sides of the same mystery: Delphine, a clairvoyant who can revisit the past, and Cynthia, an MI5 agent who interrogates suspects and searches classified archives. Examine evidence, connect the clues, and piece together a non-linear timeline to uncover the truth.
 
Inspired by Return of the Obra Dinn, The Case of the Golden Idol, and The Roottrees Are Dead, Green Mist over Portland is coming to PC via Steam in Q1 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
